ios.desc:
Crack codes. Break firewalls. Conquer the map.

Hacktivate is the ultimate cybersecurity challenge: a world map of 240 missions where every puzzle is built on real cybersecurity techniques hackers use. From classic ciphers to covert steganography, you’ll sharpen your brain while infiltrating deeper into the network.

No fluff. No filler. Just pure challenges.

Hacktivate: Education Edition is the same as the regular Hacktivate app, except it's paid up front so that schools and colleges can use it.

- 240 graded missions across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and more – unlock all the continents with a one-time purchase.
- The Hacker’s Toolbox: hashing, encryption, XOR, ciphers, and beyond.
- Real-world attack techniques through Unix terminals, web browsers, digital forensics, SQL injection, and more.
- Global progression: unlock regions and learn different specialties each time.
- Comprehensive tutorials and documentation teach you the skills you need to win.
- Difficulty that scales: from rookies breaking their first code to cyber masterminds cracking the strongest firewalls.
- Play on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a single purchase – your progress is auto-synced.

Every lock is a challenge. Every mission is a test. Every solution pulls you deeper into the system.

The network is waiting, and your mission starts now!

quotes.text: Nothing about Hacktivate is pay-to-win – you can solve every challenge without using a single hint, and even if someone does need hints there are a bunch given away for free. Even more, for people who want the game but don't want micro-transactions, there's a dedicated version of the game (https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/hacktivate-education-edition/id6754342195) that is a one-time purchase with no in-app purchases at all.
